"""RoboLab recycle_carton episode record.

The single Robot connection attempt made for this episode exhausted the client's
600-second startup wait; the service at localhost:8000 refused connections.
No observations or robot commands were available, so this record contains only
the connection/observation entry point and intentionally sends no motion.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot


def main():
    try:
        robot = Robot()  # one connection attempt; the client waits up to 600 s
        print(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))
        obs = robot.get_obs()
        out = Path("/app/output/initial_observation")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
            from PIL import Image
            Image.fromarray(frame).save(out / f"{camera}.png")
        (out / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
        print("Observation saved; no motion was sent.")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Unable to connect; no motion was sent: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
